## A — Exam authority: Renewal, privileges, registration and responsibility

The required noncommercial knowledge examination covers road rules and safe driving practices; separate manuals apply to commercial and motorcycle licensing [A10].
This dossier is limited to the standard noncommercial applicant path and the selected topic: Renewal, privileges, registration and responsibility.
Question count, passing standard, question-bank size, test duration and the effective date are not established for the official exam in the supplied safe view; their values and source pages remain null.
Private handbook edition and issuer observations are recorded in the intake receipts; they do not establish an official test threshold.
Any practice mastery target is product policy from the accepted learning loop, never the official passing standard.
